subtrees.reason: Ozone's own assets: panel sprites, per-theme check/switch/cursor art, sidebar tab icons, and the Inter UI faces that both Ozone (menu/drivers/ozone.c:9603,9632) and the on-screen notification layer (gfx/gfx_widgets.c:805-812) load. png/icons is the 46x46 low-DPI alternate icon set that only WIIU and VITA read (file_path_special.c:335-343); on Linux the icon path resolves to xmb/monochrome/png instead, so those 781 files are 3.1 MB of dead weight.

Ozone's icon source on every non-WIIU/VITA platform: APPLICATION_SPECIAL_DIRECTORY_ASSETS_OZONE_ICONS resolves to assets/xmb/monochrome/png (file_path_special.c:340-344). Missing icons clear OZONE_FLAG_HAS_ALL_ASSETS and trip the missing-assets warning. font.ttf and README.md come along because the theme's own face is one file and it makes the XMB and GLUI drivers -- both compiled into our binary -- usable for anyone who selects them.

The per-language fallback faces Ozone, MaterialUI and gfx_widgets select by exact filename when user_language is set (ozone.c:9584-9640, gfx_widgets.c:814-831, file_path_special.c:384-402), plus osd-font.ttf, which the FreeType renderer searches for as its last-resort default (gfx/drivers_font_renderer/freetype.c:393,418) and the menu screensaver names directly. pkg/wiiu is WIIU packaging art.
